Monitoring after a regulatory change

Choose the single best answer, then reveal the explanation.

A patient taking clozapine learns that the United States REMS program was removed in 2025. He asks whether this means he can stop all blood monitoring because the neutropenia risk has disappeared. Which explanation is most accurate?

  1. ANC monitoring remains recommended even though mandatory REMS participation ended
  2. Neutropenia no longer occurs with modern formulations
  3. Only a platelet count is now needed
  4. A baseline ANC permanently excludes future neutropenia
  5. Monitoring is unnecessary whenever psychiatric symptoms improve
Reveal answer and explanation
Correct answer

ANC monitoring remains recommended even though mandatory REMS participation ended

Removal of the administrative program did not eliminate the clinical risk or prescribing-information monitoring recommendations.

Understanding the options

ANC monitoring remains recommended even though mandatory REMS participation ended
Removal of the administrative program did not eliminate the clinical risk or prescribing-information monitoring recommendations.
Neutropenia no longer occurs with modern formulations
The adverse effect remains relevant.
Only a platelet count is now needed
Platelet counts do not replace assessment of neutrophils.
A baseline ANC permanently excludes future neutropenia
A baseline result does not exclude later treatment-associated changes.
Monitoring is unnecessary whenever psychiatric symptoms improve
Psychiatric response does not determine hematologic safety.
